label: IOT26-DEMO
note: Partial, manually triggered demo seeds. Each scenario is a small self-contained set that showcases one capability. Seed one, demo it, clean it, then seed the next. Isolated from the eval's IOT26-SEED label. Drive with seed/demo.py (run `list` for the catalog).

scenarios.title: Inbox triage - summarize today's emails
scenarios.shows: F1 summarization: one line per email; separates signal (a meeting, a deadline) from noise (newsletter, promo).
scenarios.expect: One line per email (sender, subject, gist); highlights Anna's meeting request and Steiner's Friday deadline; dismisses the newsletter and the promo.

scenarios.title: Deadline capture - extract deadlines into tasks
scenarios.shows: F3 extraction + Google Tasks: the due TIME goes into the task title (Tasks stores date only).
prompts: Find the deadlines in my recent emails and save each one as a task.
scenarios.expect: Creates tasks with the time embedded in the title, e.g. 'Submit intermediate report (due 15:00)', 'Pay invoice #4711 (due 15 July)', 'Send status update (due 12:00 tomorrow)'.

scenarios.title: Schedule a meeting (direct request)
scenarios.shows: F4 create_event with correct relative-date resolution ('this Friday').
prompts: Schedule a meeting titled 'IoT project sync' this Friday from 10:00 to 10:30.
scenarios.expect: Creates a calendar event on the correct upcoming Friday, 10:00-10:30, without clashing with the existing standup.

scenarios.title: Reply in context
scenarios.shows: F2 reply: recipient taken from the email being answered (a .example address - the reply safely bounces).
prompts: Reply to Anna's email and tell her Tuesday at 14:00 works for me.
scenarios.expect: Sends a reply to anna.mayer@edu-klu.example confirming Tuesday 14:00, announcing the send in one sentence first.

scenarios.title: Flagship multi-tool - summarize AND schedule

prompts: Summarize today's emails and schedule my meetings.
scenarios.expect: Summarizes the inbox, then creates events for Anna's Tuesday 14:00 sync and Max's lunch tomorrow 12:30.
